reviews.title: Love the price/performance.
reviews.comment: Very impressed so far. I use this card with the 45" LG OLED 5K/2K curved monitor and I love the combination. Looks great in the system. Good value compared to other 5080 cards. This is my first experience with the PNY brand. Time will tell, but so far I am happy with my purchase...especially with Best Buy price matching.
